items.title: How biotech executives are confronting the funding and regulatory shifts
items.summary: Amidst regulatory turmoil and a funding resurgence, companies provide insights on how they are navigating the changing industry.

items.title: UniQure to seek approval of Huntington’s gene therapy after FDA U-turn
items.summary: uniQure confirmed it will submit its BLA in Q3 2026, though there is still a required confirmatory study to conduct.

items.title: ADA26: retatrutide delivers unprecedented weight loss in Phase III TRIUMPH-1
items.summary: At ADA 2026, findings from the Phase III TRIUMPH-1 trial were presented, assessing Eli Lilly's retatrutide in adults with obesity or overweight and at least one weight-related comorbidity.

items.title: Jazz and AbCellera sign deal for T-cell engagers in solid tumours
items.summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals and AbCellera have signed a preclinical research, option, and licence agreement for the discovery and development of TCE multispecific antibodies for GI cancers and other solid tumours.

items.title: LG AI Research and D&D Pharmatech sign agreement for oral peptide drugs
items.summary: LG AI Research and D&D Pharmatech have entered into an agreement to collaborate on the development of next-generation oral peptide drugs, the companies announced following a signing ceremony held at the LG Twin Towers in Yeouido, Seoul.
